evals.prompt: My Compose app has a phone sign-in. After the user enters their number we call authApi.sendCode(phone), which returns expiresAt in epoch millis, and then show VerifyScreen. Build VerifyScreen with a 6 digit code field that fills itself from the SMS, a countdown until the code expires, and a resend button. Use auto-read-otp.
evals.expected_output: A screen using OtpInputField, SmsUserConsentEffect and CountdownTimer from the 2.x packages, verifying in onComplete, restarting SMS listening on resend and driving the timer from expiresAt.
expectations: Adds io.github.burkido:otp-bom with otp-ui and otp-sms, not otp-input, otp-timer, com.github.burkido or JitPack
Imports CountdownTimer from com.burkido.otp.ui and SmsUserConsentEffect from com.burkido.otp.sms
Calls verify only from OtpInputField's onComplete; onCodeReceive only calls fillOtp
Uses one constant for otpLength, codeLength and the fillOtp length
Changes restartKey on SmsUserConsentEffect when the user resends
Uses rememberCountdownTimerState(endTimeMillis = ...) with the backend's expiresAt
Does not add RECEIVE_SMS or READ_SMS permissions, an app hash or a BroadcastReceiver

evals.prompt: we upgraded auto-read-otp from 1.2.0 to 3.0.0 and nothing compiles anymore. the otp screen is in app/src/main/java/com/acme/auth/OtpScreen.kt, it uses SmsUserConsent, OtpInputField(textFieldState = otpState) with a custom cell lambda and rememberCountdownTimerState(endDate = ...). fix it
evals.expected_output: The migration workflow: find 1.x usages, replace coordinates and packages, convert each call site to its 2.x form, rerun the check until clean and compile.
expectations: Runs or describes scripts/find-1x-usages.sh to list remaining 1.x usages
Replaces com.github.burkido coordinates with io.github.burkido and takes CountdownTimer from otp-ui, without adding otp-timer
Rewrites SmsUserConsent to SmsUserConsentEffect with codeLength, onCodeReceive and a SmsConsentError-based onError
Changes textFieldState = to state = and the four-argument cell lambda to one taking OtpCellState
Changes endDate = to endTimeMillis =
Mentions that 2.x extracts the first run of exactly codeLength digits instead of joining every digit

evals.prompt: Using auto-read-otp 2.0 on a Pixel 6 emulator. The OTP field works if I type but the SMS consent popup never shows up. I send the text from the emulator's extended controls right when the app starts, before navigating to the verify screen. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Explains that messages arriving before SmsUserConsentEffect starts are never forwarded, and walks through the other consent sheet checks.
expectations: Identifies that the SMS was sent before SmsUserConsentEffect was in composition
Says the message needs a 4 to 10 character alphanumeric string with at least one digit
Mentions the emulator needs Google Play services
Suggests adb emu sms send after the verify screen is open
Does not suggest adding SMS permissions

evals.prompt: Users say when they enter a wrong code our OTP field shakes the first time but never again after that. We pass isError = state.wrongCode to OtpInputField and set wrongCode = true when the API returns 401.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the shake runs when isError turns from false to true, so wrongCode must be cleared when the user edits the code.
expectations: Explains the shake only runs on a false to true change of isError
Resets the error when the code is edited, with snapshotFlow on the TextFieldState or in the ViewModel's onValueChange
Does not rebuild the shake animation by hand

evals.prompt: I bumped the auto-read-otp BOM from 2.0.0 to 3.0.0 and now Gradle can't resolve io.github.burkido:otp-input or otp-timer, and none of the OtpInputField or CountdownTimer imports work
evals.expected_output: Explains that 3.0.0 merged otp-input and otp-timer into otp-ui, replaces both dependencies and switches the imports.
expectations: Says OtpInputField and CountdownTimer are in otp-ui since 3.0.0
Replaces otp-input and otp-timer with otp-ui in the build files and the version catalog
Changes com.burkido.otp.input and com.burkido.otp.timer imports to com.burkido.otp.ui
Does not pin otp-input or otp-timer to 2.0.0 as a workaround
